import html # A simple, reusable HTML skeleton for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog entry for safe web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the sanitized headline and body, ready to be inserted into a web page. Notes ----- * The function uses `html.escape` to neutralize any HTML special characters, preventing cross‑site scripting (CWE‑79). * No additional HTML tags are allowed in the input; any markup is escaped. """ # Sanitize user inputs by escaping HTML special characters. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the sanitized values into the predefined blog structure. formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content) return formatted.strip()
